Asia/Shanghai is UTC+8, Europe/London in 1715 would be using local mean time (approx UTC-0:01:15 historically, but effectively UTC+0 for this purpose).  
2 AM May 14 Shanghai (UTC+8) = 18:00 UTC previous day (May 13).  
18:00 UTC = 18:00 London time (same date as UTC).  
Thus London time is 18:00 on May 13, 1715.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1715-05-13 18:00
